direct.name: onnxruntime-node
direct.use: Runs the Auto router's local BGE encoder and BERT intent head (electron/autoRoute/squilla).
direct.ships: The N-API binding and ONNX Runtime library for the build's platform and architecture only, unpacked from the asar; macOS x64 has no build, so Auto routing is unavailable there.
direct.license: MIT, Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation (the package declares MIT and ships no license file; the text is ONNX Runtime's, in docs/licenses/onnxruntime-LICENSE.txt)

notices.title: OpenSquilla (https://github.com/TokenRhythm/opensquilla, commit 96ad3e4, Apache-2.0): SquillaRouter's model weights, shipped unchanged in resources/auto-route; its feature pipeline, model policy and tokenizer contract ported to JavaScript in electron/autoRoute/squilla; and its fitted TF-IDF, SVD, PCA and scaler parameters, converted to plain arrays in electron/autoRoute/squilla/params
